The problem isn’t just fees or restrictions—it’s infrastructure dependency. This analysis compares your real options for accepting Bitcoin (and other cryptocurrencies) directly, without intermediaries. The goal is clear: to give you infrastructure you own, not rent. No workarounds. No platforms that can cut you off. Just sovereign commerce stacks built to withstand the exact pressures you face.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

CoinGate provides a managed payment gateway with 50+ cryptocurrencies, but it requires KYC for withdrawals above €1,000. NOWPayments offers 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC, automatic webhook-based delivery, and a flat 0.5% fee. Self-hosted solutions like the COREMERCH Complete Builder Kit give you full ownership of the infrastructure, using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for automation, and Google Drive for file delivery. CoinGate and NOWPayments are plug-and-play but keep you dependent on their platforms. Self-hosted stacks eliminate all third-party risks but require initial setup. If you value sovereignty over convenience, self-hosted wins. If you need speed without technical depth, NOWPayments is the better choice.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

CoinGate blocks users from sanctioned countries outright, making it unusable in regions like Zimbabwe or Venezuela. NOWPayments operates without geographic restrictions, as it doesn’t hold funds—payments go directly to your wallet. Self-hosted solutions are inherently sovereign: since you control the hosting, backend, and delivery, no entity can shut you down. For creators in Kenya or other restricted regions, self-hosted stacks are the only option that guarantees uninterrupted operation. CoinGate’s country restrictions make it a non-starter. NOWPayments works but still relies on their infrastructure. Self-hosted stacks are built to withstand financial isolation—they’re pressure-tested against actual currency collapse and payment rejection.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

CoinGate charges 1% + network fees, with settlements taking up to 24 hours. NOWPayments charges 0.5% with instant on-chain verification and automatic delivery via webhooks. Self-hosted solutions using NOWPayments retain the 0.5% fee but eliminate recurring costs—you pay once for the stack and own it forever. CoinGate’s higher fees and slower settlements make it inefficient for low-margin products. NOWPayments is faster but still rents you access to their platform. Self-hosted stacks have the highest upfront cost ($197 for the Complete Builder Kit) but zero recurring fees. If you’re selling high-volume digital products, self-hosted pays for itself by eliminating platform taxes.
Self-hosted stacks give you full ownership of your commerce infrastructure—no platform can shut you down.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

CoinGate and NOWPayments automate payment verification but require you to host files elsewhere and manually trigger deliveries. Self-hosted stacks automate everything: payment verification, order storage, and file delivery. With COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit, you own the GitHub Pages site, Cloudflare Workers scripts, and Google Drive storage. No platform can revoke your access. CoinGate and NOWPayments are convenient but keep critical infrastructure out of your hands. Self-hosted stacks give you full data ownership and operational control. For creators who want to build once and own forever, self-hosted is the only option.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a sanctioned country or face frequent payment rejections, self-hosted stacks are your only reliable option. If you need speed and don’t mind platform dependency, NOWPayments is a solid choice. CoinGate is viable only if you’re in an unrestricted country and prioritize minimal setup. For Kenyan creators selling ebooks, courses, or templates, the COREMERCH Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides the sovereignty and automation you need. It’s not the cheapest upfront, but it’s the only architecture that eliminates all third-party risks. Choose based on your tolerance for dependency—not on convenience alone.

If you’re ready to own your commerce infrastructure instead of renting it, the COREMERCH Complete Builder Kit is your starting point. It includes all 6 sovereign stack blueprints, 7 deployment templates, and a NOWPayments integration guide. Deploy once, own forever. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Built for creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for basic needs or the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for advanced automation. 2. Deploy hosting: Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free, static site hosting. 3. Set up backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate payment verification and file delivery. 4. Configure storage: Use Supabase or Google Sheets for order tracking and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage. 5. Integrate payments: Use NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing with a 0.5% fee. 6. Load products: Add your ebooks, courses, or templates to the system. 7. Test end-to-end: Ensure payments trigger automatic file delivery. 8. Launch: Publish your store and start selling globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use these solutions if I’m in a sanctioned country?

Self-hosted stacks work in any country because you control the infrastructure. CoinGate blocks sanctioned countries, and NOWPayments operates without geographic restrictions but relies on their platform. Self-hosted is the only fully sovereign option.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON—all under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need technical skills to set this up?
Basic technical skills are required for self-hosted stacks. The COREMERCH Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step blueprints and templates to guide you through deployment.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
If you’re using a self-hosted stack, your store remains operational because you control the hosting and backend logic. NOWPayments is only one component—not the entire system.
Is there a monthly fee?
Self-hosted stacks have no recurring fees. You pay once for the stack and own it forever. CoinGate and NOWPayments charge per-transaction fees but no subscriptions.
